milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Yellow stained glass panes are at (1-2, 0-1, -7) spawn-relative in the north corridor behind a wall with doorway. Player must navigate through doorway at (3, z=-2) to get within 5 blocks. max_distance=5 ensures player cannot satisfy this from spawn (distance ~7.1 from origin).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Green stained glass panes are at (8-9, 0-1, -1) spawn-relative in the east wing, separated ~10 blocks from yellow panes. Player must navigate through doorway at (3, z=2) to reach this area. Cannot trigger from spawn (distance ~8.1).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Soul sand is in the nether corner room at (8-11, -1 to 0, -9 to -11) spawn-relative, gated behind a wall with doorway at (6, z=-5). Player must navigate through glass pane areas first. Cannot trigger from spawn (distance ~13.4).

Uses inventory_has because mining a red tulip drops it as an item that enters the player's inventory. Player starts without any red_tulip in inventory. Tulips are placed on grass blocks at (-7 to -8, 0, 2-3) in the garden area.

Uses count_in_box_at_least with kind='block' because potting a flower transforms the empty flower_pot block into a potted_red_tulip block at (-6, 0, 3). This is the correct way to detect the 'use item on block' interaction. Box generously encompasses the garden area where the flower pot is located.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Smithing table is at (5, 0, 3) spawn-relative in the metalworking zone, accessed through doorway at (3, z=2). Distance from spawn is ~5.8, and the wall at x=3 blocks direct access requiring doorway navigation.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a golden shovel places it in the player's inventory. Player starts with 1 gold ingot + 2 sticks (correct recipe) but no golden_shovel. Crafting table at (6, 0, 3) is adjacent to smithing table.

Uses inventory_has because crafting iron leggings places them in the player's inventory. Player starts with 7 iron ingots (correct recipe) but no iron_leggings. Uses same crafting table at (6, 0, 3) after completing golden shovel.

Uses inventory_has because crafting oak slabs (3 planks → 6 slabs) places them in the player's inventory. Player starts with 3 oak planks but no oak_slab. Woodworking crafting table at (-2, 0, -6) in the north anteroom.

Uses inventory_has because mining a bed drops it as an item that enters the player's inventory. Player starts without any orange_bed. Bed is at (-7, 0, -7/-8) in the NW bedroom, gated behind doorway at (-4, z=-6) past the woodworking area.
